decisions.reason: The operator line was a visible, resource-heavy commitment central to the one-source garage door offering, so management persists with it despite the lack of recent visibility on the website.

The solid wood door is a low-visibility niche variant and its disappearance from the website since 2019 raises doubts, but it still fits the customization promise and its weak results can be blamed on temporary pandemic-era disruption.
The remote-controlled operator complements the operator line the firm committed to, and dropping it would undercut the justification for that investment.
Glazed industrial sectional doors belong to the core industrial range, and their shared tooling and sunk costs favor persistence.
The insulated glazed variant supports the announced thermal-solution direction, so management keeps it despite limited recent visibility.
As a prominently featured launch with its own page, its public commitment and sunk marketing costs make withdrawal unlikely.
